text: Le Coq Sportif, the French sportswear company, has been bought by a group led by Franco-Swiss entrepreneur Dan Mamane, whose proposal the Paris Commercial Court ruled in favour of in July 2025; the brand was previously owned by Swiss-based private equity firm Airesis.

source.name: SportsPro: Le Coq Sportif out of receivership as new owner plans '€70m' investment
source.quote: Struggling French sportswear company Le Coq Sportif has been bought by a group led by Franco-Swiss entrepreneur Dan Mamane.
source.note: The same article states the Paris Commercial Court 'ruled in favour of the proposal put forward by Mamane' and that 'Founded in 1882, Le Coq Sportif was owned by Swiss-based private equity firm Airesis'.

additionalSources.name: SGB Media: EXEC: Le Coq Sportif Sold in Bankruptcy Proceedings
additionalSources.quote: Le Coq Sportif, in receivership, has been acquired by a group led by Franco-Swiss entrepreneur Dan Mamane.
additionalSources.note: SGB Media also states: 'Le Coq Sportif has been owned since 2005 by Marc-Henri Beausire's Swiss group Airesis' and 'Mamane's consortium is backed by the Mirabaud Patrimoine Vivant investment fund'.
